name: Rappels quotidiens Mombongo (alertes + récap ventes)

on:
  schedule:
    # 05:00 UTC = 06:00 à Kinshasa (Africa/Kinshasa, UTC+1, pas de changement d'heure)
    - cron: '0 5 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch: {}

jobs:
  daily-recap:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Cloner le dépôt
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Installer Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Installer les dépendances
        working-directory: ./scripts
        run: npm install

      - name: Envoyer le rappel quotidien
        working-directory: ./scripts
        env:
          FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}
        run: node send-daily-recap.js

      - name: Envoyer le récap de ventes quotidien (Business & Pro)
        working-directory: ./scripts
        env:
          FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}
        run: node send-daily-sales-recap.js
